node.title: Re^3: filesystems & Perl (updated!)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [harangzsolt33],

Yes, exactly what [hippo] [id://1169698|said] - a database can solve all of the problems you named. You'll find many tutorials on [mod://DBI] on the web, including several [id://519628|on this site].

Historically one might have solved this using [doc://flock] to control read/write access, but that can be finicky and hard to get right (assuming it even works on your OS+FS); so I suggest you spend your time learning some basic [mod://DBI] instead.

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
